meta_title: Visi Painter & Decorator | Professional Painting Nottingham

hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting that looks immaculate and lasts. Free quote within 48 hours.
services_heading: Professional Painting & Decorating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to exterior protection, we handle residential and commercial projects with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature finishes. We prep thoroughly, use quality paints, and leave your home spotless—transforming tired rooms into spaces you'll love.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with durable exterior paint and render finishing. We work in all seasons and protect your property against Nottingham's rain and wind.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional hanging of traditional wallpaper, vinyl, and modern wall coverings. Perfect pattern matching and flawless seams, every time.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, architraves, and built-ins painted to a showroom finish. Undercoating, sanding, and multiple coats ensure colour and durability.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and holiday lets painted quickly and with minimal disruption. We work around your schedule and use eco-friendly materials where possible.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Effects
services.desc: Faux finishes, colour blocking, murals, and bespoke paint effects. Bring your design vision to life with our creative team.

about_pullquote: We paint homes, not just walls. Your vision matters to us.
about_para_1: Visi Painter and Decorator was founded on the principle that quality decoration shouldn't break the bank or leave your home in chaos. Over 12 years, we've built a reputation across Nottingham for meticulous preparation, colour-matched finishes, and honest pricing. Every job—whether a bedroom refresh or a full commercial refit—receives the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we listen. We'll assess your room's light, suggest colours that work, and explain why a proper undercoat matters. We're insured, reliable, and we tidy as we go. Many of our jobs come from word-of-mouth and repeat customers who know we'll show up on time, do the job right, and leave the place as we found it.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Visi

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs redecorated—living room, hallway, and kitchen. Mark was professional from start to finish, suggested a couple of colour changes I wouldn't have thought of, and the finish is absolutely immaculate. He was here when he said he'd be and cleaned up every day. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Needed our Victorian terrace exterior freshened up before selling. Visi sorted the woodwork and rendered front in under two weeks. The attention to detail on the skirting and around the windows was brilliant. We sold quickly and the agent said the kerb appeal made a real difference.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Wallpapered our guest bedroom with a tricky patterned paper—corners, sloped ceiling, the lot. No complaints about the seams or the pattern match. The lads were respectful in our home, worked efficiently, and the room looks stunning. Top job.
reviews.author: James M.
